searchText: To my understanding, Ethereum Interop is primarily for client developers to collaborate on testing and ensuring interoperability of EIPs targeted for upcoming network upgrades. Unfortunately, I’m not aware of any virtual meetings being held as part of Ethereum Interop. Might want to follow <#892088344438255616> to follow progress.
